items.title: California attorney general subpoenas Nvidia amid China chip and disclosure inquiry
items.summary: California's attorney general issued an investigative subpoena to Nvidia regarding whether advanced chips or confidential information reached China and whether investors were misled. The inquiry is confirmed, but wrongdoing has not been established. Nvidia shares declined in early premarket trading, adding legal uncertainty despite recent strong revenue growth.

observations.label: November 20 premarket indicative quote
observations.value: NVDA approximately $142.35, -2.49% versus prior close; time of individual quote not specified by quote provider; not a confirmed close

observations.label: November 19 official legal catalyst
observations.value: California DOJ investigative subpoena concerning possible transfer of advanced chips/confidential information to China and investor statements; no finding of violation

observations.label: Assessment, risks and invalidation
observations.value: Strong chip revenue versus governance, export compliance and legal costs; monitor Nvidia disclosures, California DOJ actions, congressional testimony and customer orders; exculpatory findings weaken legal risk

items.key_finding: Verified subpoena introduces compliance uncertainty, not proof of export violations or demand collapse.

items.title: Intuit cuts fiscal 2027 revenue outlook and agrees to sell Mailchimp
items.summary: Intuit lowered its annual revenue outlook because of weaker Credit Karma expectations despite solid quarterly profit growth. The company also agreed to sell Mailchimp to Bending Spoons. Shares dropped sharply in premarket indications, making this a material software-growth versus valuation watch; transaction closing and future guidance remain uncertain.

observations.label: November 20 5:09 AM EST premarket report
observations.value: INTU approximately $274.52, -11.4% indicated; premarket not closing move

observations.label: Intuit official November 19 Q1 FY27 earnings
observations.value: Revenue $4.4B, +12% YoY; online ecosystem revenue +20%; adjusted EPS $2.91

observations.label: FY27 guidance and divestiture
observations.value: Revenue $23.081B-$23.365B; Mailchimp sale ~$3.68B ($3.31B cash and $368M Bending Spoons shares), planned early-2027 close

observations.label: Risks and next checks
observations.value: Credit Karma business trajectory, organic software growth, customer retention, profitability and deal approvals; improved guidance and conversion would weaken selloff rationale

items.key_finding: Intuit's guidance reduction drove sharp premarket weakness despite operating growth and a major planned divestiture.

sources.title: Intuit official November 19 fiscal Q1 results and Mailchimp agreement
MarketWatch November 20 outlook and price reaction

items.title: Asia semiconductor-heavy markets drop over five percent as AI risk-off spreads globally
items.summary: Taiwan, South Korea and Japan equities suffered sharp declines following a broad US technology selloff. Chipmakers, memory suppliers and semiconductor equipment names were among the hardest hit. This suggests cross-market risk reduction and valuation pressure, but does not independently demonstrate weakening chip orders or shipments.

observations.label: November 20 Asia market close, local exchanges
observations.value: Taiwan Taiex approximately -6.2%; South Korea Kospi -5.2%; Japan Nikkei -5.1%; session closes reported by independent market coverage

observations.label: November 20 7:02 AM EST US futures
observations.value: Nasdaq-100 futures approximately -1.1%; intraday indication, not closing return

observations.label: Risks, fundamentals and next checks
observations.value: Cross-market deleveraging and valuation sensitivity versus still-substantial data-center demand; monitor TSMC bookings, chip orders, memory prices, Treasury yields, credit spreads and market breadth; improving demand and breadth weaken selloff thesis

items.key_finding: AI-led risk-off has broadened across Asia's major chip markets without verified semiconductor demand collapse.

items.title: Intel reports first external 18A-P customer and expanded Microsoft packaging agreement
items.summary: Intel disclosed its first external customer for advanced 18A-P manufacturing and an expanded Azure infrastructure collaboration with Microsoft involving EMIB packaging. These developments provide commercial validation, but the customer identity, manufacturing volumes and contract economics remain undisclosed. Profitable production at scale is not yet established.

observations.label: November 19, 8:08 AM EST premarket
observations.value: INTC $57.37, +4.94%; indicative premarket quote, not closing price

observations.label: Foundry announcement
observations.value: First external customer for 18A-P disclosed; identity, order size and economics unknown

observations.label: Microsoft agreement
observations.value: Expanded Azure collaboration involving EMIB advanced packaging and Xeon supply

observations.label: Risks and next checks
observations.value: Manufacturing yields, qualification timelines, named customers, volume production, capital expenditure and foundry operating losses; weak yields or contracts would invalidate thesis

items.key_finding: Intel has outside commercial foundry validation, but scale and profitability remain unproven.

items.title: IEA World Energy Outlook models long-run shift away from Hormuz exposure
items.summary: The IEA's World Energy Outlook 2026 models lower future dependence on the Strait of Hormuz under a prolonged disruption scenario, partly through alternative pipelines and energy-system changes. These are conditional scenarios, not forecasts or newly observed shipment losses. The report raises longer-run questions about infrastructure investment and energy-security costs.

observations.label: Scenario, not observed transit
observations.value: Approximately 20M barrels/day pre-crisis Hormuz oil transit versus modeled 8.5M in 2030 and below 2M in 2035 in an extreme scenario

observations.label: Proposed alternatives
observations.value: Approximately 7M barrels/day additional bypass-pipeline capacity under construction or proposed, not all completed

observations.label: Risks and next indicators
observations.value: Project approvals, funding, construction schedules, confirmed export flows, security of alternative routes, MARAD/UKMTO and Brent/WTI; de-escalation or delays change scenario

items.key_finding: IEA scenarios suggest major potential reconfiguration of oil routes, not verified new physical-flow changes.
